scripts.check: vp run audit && vp run typecheck && vp run lint && vp run test && vp run react-doctor && vp run fallow
scripts.codegen: vp run codegen:routes && vp run codegen:auth && vp run codegen:convex
scripts.fallow: vp exec fallow -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc --fail-on-issues && vp exec fallow -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc health --css
scripts.fallow:changed: vp exec fallow audit -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc --changed-since HEAD --gate all && vp exec fallow security -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc --changed-since HEAD --gate new
scripts.fallow:strict: vp exec fallow -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc --fail-on-issues --type-aware-require complete && vp exec fallow -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc health --css --type-aware-require complete
scripts.format: vp exec syncpack format --config tooling/syncpack.config.json && vp check --fix
scripts.format:check: vp exec syncpack format --check --config tooling/syncpack.config.json && vp fmt --check
scripts.hosting:upload:landing: vp exec static-hosting upload --component landing --dist apps/landing/dist --no-spa --build-command 'vp run build:landing'
scripts.hosting:upload:web: vp exec static-hosting upload --component web --dist apps/web/dist --build-command 'STATIC_HOSTING_BASE_PATH=/app/ vp run build:web'
scripts.lint: vp run lint:conventions && vp run lint:claude && vp run lint:packages && vp check
scripts.lint:packages: vp exec syncpack lint --config tooling/syncpack.config.json && vp exec syncpack format --check --config tooling/syncpack.config.json
scripts.react-doctor:changed: vp exec react-doctor -y --blocking warning --scope changed --base origin/main --no-dead-code --no-score .
scripts.showcase: vp run seed --scale realistic && vp run --fail-if-no-match --filter @groam/showcase showcase
scripts.test: vp run test:quality && vp run --fail-if-no-match --filter "@groam/*" --cache --concurrency-limit 2 test
scripts.test:packages: vp run test:quality && vp run --fail-if-no-match --filter "@groam/*" --filter "!@groam/web" --filter "!@groam/landing" --filter "!@groam/ui" --filter "!@groam/ai" --filter "!@groam/auth" --cache --concurrency-limit 2 test
scripts.test:ui: vp run --fail-if-no-match --filter @groam/ui --filter @groam/ai --filter @groam/auth --cache --concurrency-limit 2 test && vp run --fail-if-no-match --filter @groam/showcase test:browser
